def advance (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g x : E) : E :=
  project V (x - η • g)

def iterate (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g : ℕ → E) (x0 : E) : ℕ → E
  | 0 => x0
  | t + 1 => advance V η (g t) (iterate V η g x0 t)

def regret (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (g : ℕ → E) (x0 u : E) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ range T, inner ℝ (g t) (prediction V η g x0 t - u)

nodes.mathematicalExplanation: For any starting point x, positive eta and feasible comparator u, the updated point p=P_V(x-eta g) satisfies a one-step loss bound with both negative distance and movement terms.
nodes.proofExplanation: The projection variational inequality gives <x-eta g-p,u-p> <= 0, hence eta<g,p-u> <= <x-p,p-u>. Expand ||x-u|| squared as ||x-p|| squared + 2<x-p,p-u> + ||p-u|| squared, then divide by positive 2 eta. The starting point x may lie outside V.

nodes.mathematicalExplanation: Two vector sequences that agree through the current index t produce the same prediction p_t from the same initial center and fixed step.
nodes.proofExplanation: Induct on the number n of updates. Agreement for all s<n gives the same previous state and the same vector at update n-1. Apply this statement at n=t+1. Agreement only for s<t is not sufficient.
